body.x: Celluon(CEO Ray Cha, www.celluon.com) showed off 'Epic' at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.
With full-size QWERTY keyboard, Epic is wireless projection keyboard which connects with any bluetooth HID devices. Built-in lithium-ion polymer battery lasts two hours.
'Epic' is compatible operating systems: iOS 4+, Android 4.0+, Windows XP+, Mac OS X, Blackberry 10, bluetooth HID devices, and most of desk tops.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
